caption: The drawing depicts a folded quilt with a patchwork design, featuring geometric patterns and horizontal bands. The quilt primarily consists of dark reddish-brown sections with light-colored, irregular zigzag stitching. There are also central diamond and triangular patches with a tan background, decorated with large, multicolored floral motifs in shades of pink, red, green, yellow, and blue. Towards the bottom, there are several horizontally aligned bands with intricate floral and ornamental patterns in muted tones of brown, beige, black, and hints of red. The entire composition is rendered with attention to fabric textures, patterns, and color contrasts, and the quilt rests on a plain, off-white background. Handwritten text appears in small script on the lower left side, reading "Hex Cloth" and "Sylvia Delsin" (the second line is slightly unclear in the image).
title: Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
